title: Mandated vs. Voluntary Adaptation to Natural Disasters: The Case of U.S. Wildfires
abstract: Despite escalating disaster losses and predicted increases in weather-related catastrophes, takeup of protective technologies and behaviors appears limited by myopia, externalities, and other factors. One response to such frictions is to mandate adaptive investment. We measure the effect of California's wildfire building codes on own- and neighboring structure survival using administrative damage and assessment data for most US homes experiencing wildfires since 2000. Differences across jurisdictions and vintages reveal remarkable resilience effects of building codes initially prompted by the deadly 1991 Oakland Firestorm. Codes also benefit neighbors. We use the results to estimate net social benefits of wildfire building standards.
abstract_zh: 尽管灾害损失不断攀升，且预计与天气相关的灾难将增加，但保护性技术和行为的采用仍因短视、外部性等因素而受到限制。应对此类摩擦的一种方式是强制要求进行适应性投资。我们利用2000年以来经历野火的美国大部分住宅的行政损毁和评估数据，衡量加利福尼亚州野火建筑规范对本住宅及相邻建筑存留率的影响。不同辖区和不同建造年代之间的差异揭示，最初由1991年致命的奥克兰火风暴推动制定的建筑规范具有显著的韧性效应。这些规范同时也惠及邻居。我们利用这些结果估算了野火建筑标准的净社会效益。

title: The Efficiency and Equity Impacts of Risk Classification in Catastrophe Insurance
venue: NBER Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy

title: Using Markets to Adapt to Climate Change
Cutting Costs or Cutting Corners: Asset Reallocation in Oil and Gas Production
abstract: Reallocation of assets across firms can lead to efficiency gains, but it can also lead to distortions via rent-seeking. We examine the link between asset reallocation and rent-seeking enabled by differences in the expected cost of environmental liabilities. Focusing on the US oil and gas industry, we develop a conceptual framework that incorporates both firm specialization in well types and the judgment-proof problem, by which undercapitalized firms can avoid environmental liabilities. We then build a novel dataset with hundreds of thousands of well transfers over 1992 to 2023, showing that oil and gas wells are transferred frequently, particularly as they age and their revenues decline. Moreover, low-value wells are especially likely to be transferred to low-value firms. Transferred wells produce similar amounts in later years, but are less likely to be plugged – thus posing greater environmental risk. We conclude with policy implications related to well plugging, bonding requirements, and decarbonization. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 企业之间的资产再配置可能带来效率提升，但也可能通过寻租导致扭曲。我们考察了环境负债预期成本差异所促成的资产再配置与寻租之间的联系。以美国石油和天然气行业为研究对象，我们构建了一个概念框架，同时纳入了企业在油井类型上的专业化，以及资本不足企业可以逃避环境负债的“无偿付能力”问题。随后，我们构建了一个新颖的数据集，涵盖1992年至2023年间数十万次油井转让，结果表明油气井转让十分频繁，尤其是在油井老化、收入下降之后。此外，低价值油井尤其容易被转让给低价值企业。被转让的油井在之后几年的产量相近，但被封井的可能性更低，因此带来了更大的环境风险。最后，我们提出了与油井封堵、保证金要求和脱碳相关的政策启示。美国国家经济研究局（NBER）工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民可免费从www.nber.org下载本文。

title: Incentivizing Self-Protection from Wildfires
abstract: Losses from natural disasters can be mitigated through investments in property protection, yet adoption of low-cost risk-reducing measures remains low. In wildfire-exposed areas, managing vegetation and other fuels next to homes decreases structure vulnerability, but few properties comply with best practices despite widespread outreach efforts. We report on two randomized field experiments that incentivized thousands of Oregon homeowners to participate in pre-existing fire department programs to reduce wildfire risk. Across both experiments, financial incentives of $100 to $500 resulted in up to 12% of homeowners scheduling free defensible space assessments, while information-only approaches achieved assessment takeup rates of 3% at most. Responses to subsidies are largest among owners of more valuable homes, while baseline wildfire risk does not predict responsiveness. On-the-ground and remotely-sensed measures of vegetation provide noisy estimates of treatment effects on endline vegetation. Finally, we consider the extent to which the estimated behavioral elasticities from these experiments might shed light on potential homeowner responses to pricing of wildfire risk reductions in home insurance premiums, a practice that is becoming more common due to technological and regulatory changes. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 自然灾害造成的损失可以通过投资于财产保护来减轻，但采取低成本降低风险措施的比例仍然很低。在野火高发地区，管理住宅周边的植被和其他易燃物可以降低建筑物的脆弱性，但尽管开展了广泛的宣传工作，仍然只有少数房产遵循最佳实践。我们报告了两项随机化现场实验，它们激励了数千名俄勒冈州的房主参加既有的消防部门计划，以降低野火风险。在两项实验中，100至500美元的经济激励使多达12%的房主预约了免费的可防御空间评估，而仅提供信息的方式，评估预约率最多仅为3%。补贴的反应在房屋价值较高的房主中最为强烈，而基线野火风险并不能预测其反应程度。通过实地和遥感测量的植被数据，对终期植被的处理效应只能给出有噪声的估计。最后，我们探讨了这些实验估计的行为弹性在多大程度上可以揭示房主对家庭保险保费中野火风险降低定价的可能反应，由于技术和监管变化，这一做法正变得越来越普遍。美国国家经济研究局（NBER）工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民可免费从www.nber.org下载本文。

title: Pricing Climate Risk: Hurricane Models and Home Insurance Over the Last Two Decades
abstract: To what extent do rising homeowners insurance premiums reflect growing climate risk? We examine hurricane risk in Florida and how insurers price it. Insurers rely on proprietary, third-party catastrophe models that estimate property-level expected losses. Using data from these models, we describe estimated hurricane risk across the state and how it evolved from 2006 to 2023. Expected property losses from hurricanes increased by 50%. Turning to insurance prices, we collect the premium rate filing data for insurers representing 70% of the total market. Insurers wanting to adjust their hurricane premium rates must file a request with the state regulator and justify the change with hurricane model output. Leveraging discrete updates to hurricane models, we estimate that a $1 increase in expected losses increases hurricane premiums by $5.82. Overall, hurricane premiums increased by more than 200% during our period of study. We consider potential mechanisms and find that the large markup above expected loss appears to reflect 1) reliance in the insurance market on local, limitedly diversified insurers, paired with 2) the rising cost of reinsurance.
abstract_zh: 房主保险保费的上涨在多大程度上反映了日益增长的气候风险？我们考察了佛罗里达州的飓风风险及保险公司对其定价的方式。保险公司依赖专有的第三方巨灾模型，这些模型估计财产层面的预期损失。利用这些模型的数据，我们描述了全州估计的飓风风险，以及其在2006年至2023年间的演变。飓风造成的预期财产损失增加了50%。就保险价格而言，我们收集了占全市场总额70%的保险公司的费率备案数据。希望调整飓风保费费率的保险公司必须向州监管机构提交申请，并以飓风模型的输出结果证明调整的合理性。利用飓风模型的离散更新，我们估计预期损失每增加1美元，飓风保费增加5.82美元。总体而言，在我们的研究期间，飓风保费上涨了200%以上。我们考察了可能的机制，发现预期损失之上的大幅加成似乎反映了：1）保险市场依赖于本地化、多元化程度有限的保险公司，以及2）再保险成本的上升。

title: The Distribution and Consequences of Natural Disasters: Evidence from U.S. Wildfire Victims
abstract: The economic burden of natural disasters is shaped by who is exposed, who experiences losses, how those losses alter individual economic trajectories, and how affected communities evolve in the aftermath. We link property-level damage data from over 100 U.S. wildfires to administrative tax and Census data to understand individual-level relationships between disaster damage and economic outcomes. Residents of burned areas are wealthier than the U.S. population on average, but within these wildfire perimeters the likelihood that a home burns is negatively correlated with pre-fire income. Home destruction imposes costs beyond rebuilding the property: occupants of destroyed homes experience lower income for three years post-fire, producing cumulative income losses equal to 26 percent of pre-fire annual income. We do not detect income or employment effects for residents without direct property damage. Community recovery is slow and accompanied by changes in composition. Four years after a fire, half of destroyed addresses remain unoccupied and reoccupied addresses house residents with substantially higher incomes than before.
abstract_zh: 自然灾害的经济负担，取决于谁暴露于灾害之中、谁遭受损失、这些损失如何改变个人的经济轨迹，以及受影响社区在灾后如何演变。我们将来自100多场美国野火的房产层面损毁数据与行政税收和人口普查数据相连接，以理解灾害损毁与经济结果之间的个体层面关系。烧毁地区的居民平均而言比美国总体人口更富裕，但在这些野火边界之内，房屋被烧毁的可能性与火灾发生前的收入呈负相关。房屋被毁所带来的成本不仅限于重建房产：房屋被毁居民在火灾后三年内收入下降，累计收入损失相当于火灾前年收入的26%。对于没有直接房产损失的居民，我们未发现收入或就业效应。社区恢复缓慢，并伴随着构成的变化。火灾发生四年后，一半被毁地址仍无人居住，而重新入住的地址中，居民的收入明显高于此前。

title: When Do Environmental Externalities Have Electoral Consequences? Evidence from Fracking
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: The electoral salience of some issues may diminish when one politician has authority over many policy areas. This study measures the role of environmental regulation in concurrent elections for governors and specialized energy regulators in two U.S. states. I first show that while both offices can influence environmental and energy policies, quantitative analysis of campaign news coverage reveals clear differences in the importance of these issues in the two races. Next, I use geologic variation in earthquakes caused by oil and gas production to measure the electoral consequences of a costly environmental externality. There are measurable effects only in the energy regulator race. These results are consistent with theories of issue bundling. Finally, the unbundling effects that I measure appear to be themselves limited by voter attentiveness and partisanship.
abstract_zh: 当一位政治人物掌握多个政策领域的权力时，某些议题的选举显著性可能会下降。本研究衡量了环境监管在美国两个州同期举行的州长选举和专业能源监管机构选举中的作用。我首先表明，尽管两个职位都能影响环境和能源政策，但对竞选新闻报道的定量分析显示，这些议题在两场选举中的重要性存在明显差异。随后，我利用石油和天然气生产引发地震的地质变异，衡量一项代价高昂的环境外部性的选举后果。只有在能源监管机构的选举中才存在可测量的影响。这些结果与议题捆绑理论相一致。最后，我所衡量的议题解绑效应本身似乎也受到选民关注度和党派立场的限制。

title: How Are Insurance Markets Adapting to Climate Change? Risk Selection and Regulation in the Market for Homeowners Insurance
Adapting to Growing Wildfire Property Risk
Quantifying Fire-Specific Smoke Exposure and Health Impacts
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

title: The Economic Incidence of Wildfire Suppression in the United States
abstract: This study measures the degree to which public expenditures on wild-fire protection subsidize development in harm’s way. We use administrative data on firefighting expenditures to measure the causal effect of nearby homes on the amount spent to extinguish wildfires. We use these estimates in an actuarial calculation yielding geographically differentiated expected implicit subsidies for homes across the western United States. The expected net present value of this subsidy can exceed 20 percent of home value, increases with fire hazard, and decreases surprisingly steeply with development density. We discuss potential behavioral responses by individuals and local governments using a simple economic model. (JEL D91, Q23, Q54, R52, R58)
abstract_zh: 本研究衡量了野火防护的公共支出在多大程度上补贴了处于危险之中的开发活动。我们利用消防支出的行政数据，衡量附近住宅对扑灭野火所花费金额的因果效应。我们将这些估计值用于精算计算，得出美国西部各地住宅地理差异化的预期隐性补贴。该补贴的预期净现值可超过房产价值的20%，随火灾危险程度上升而增加，并且随开发密度下降的速度之快出人意料。我们利用一个简单的经济模型，讨论了个人和地方政府可能的行为反应。（JEL D91, Q23, Q54, R52, R58）

title: Wildfire Insurance, Information, and Self-Protection
abstract: Like other climate-related disasters, wildfires are intensifying. Property owners can reduce their vulnerability to wildfire losses but are not well informed about the costs and benefits of available self-protection investments. Technological advances mean that insurers are increasingly able to monitor household mitigation behavior. We revisit the problem of self-protection from risk in a setting where households have incomplete insurance and limited information about self-protection investments. Insurer discounts for self-protection generate additional value by informing households about self-protection investments that also reduce uninsured losses. This information provision increases the responsiveness of self-protection to ex post disaster assistance, with implications for optimal government transfers.
abstract_zh: 与其他气候相关灾害一样，野火正在加剧。房产所有者可以降低其对野火损失的脆弱性，但对于可供选择的自我保护投资的成本与收益，他们了解得并不充分。技术进步意味着保险公司越来越能够监测家庭的减灾行为。我们在家庭保险不完全、且对自我保护投资信息有限的情形下，重新审视了风险自我保护问题。保险公司对自我保护的折扣，通过向家庭提供自我保护投资的信息，创造了额外价值，因为这些投资同样能减少未投保的损失。这种信息提供增强了自我保护行为对灾后事后援助的反应，并对最优政府转移支付具有启示意义。

title: Do Energy Efficiency Investments Deliver at the Right Time?
abstract: Most analyses of energy efficiency investments ignore that the value of electricity varies widely across hours. We show how much timing matters. Using novel hourly consumption data from an air conditioner rebate program in California, we find that energy savings are concentrated in high-value hours. This significantly increases the value of these investments, especially after we account for the large capacity payments that electricity generators receive to guarantee supply in peak hours. We then use engineering predictions to calculate timing premiums for a wide range of energy efficiency investments, finding substantial variation in economic value across investments. (JEL L94, L98, Q41, Q48)
abstract_zh: 大多数能效投资分析忽视了电力价值在不同小时之间存在巨大差异这一事实。我们表明时机的重要性有多大。利用加利福尼亚州空调返利项目中新颖的逐小时用电数据，我们发现节约的能源集中于高价值时段。这显著提高了这些投资的价值，尤其是在我们考虑了发电企业为保障高峰时段供电而获得的大额容量支付之后。随后，我们利用工程预测，为各类能效投资计算了时间溢价，发现不同投资的经济价值存在显著差异。（JEL L94, L98, Q41, Q48）

title: Drilling Like There's No Tomorrow: Bankruptcy, Insurance, and Environmental Risk
abstract: This paper measures the effects of bankruptcy protection on industry structure and environmental outcomes in oil and gas extraction. Using administrative data from Texas, I exploit variation in an insurance requirement that reduced firms’ ability to avoid liability through bankruptcy. Among small firms, the policy substantially improved environmental outcomes and reduced production. Most production was reallocated to larger firms with better environmental records, but high-cost production where social cost may have exceeded social benefit decreased. These results suggest that incomplete internalization of environmental costs due to bankruptcy is an important determinant of industry structure and safety effort in hazardous industries. (JEL G22, G33, L25, L71, Q35, Q52)
abstract_zh: 本文衡量了破产保护对石油和天然气开采行业产业结构及环境结果的影响。我利用得克萨斯州的行政数据，借助一项保险要求的变化，该要求降低了企业通过破产规避责任的能力。在小企业中，该政策显著改善了环境结果，并减少了产量。大部分产量被重新配置给了环境记录更好的大企业，而社会成本可能超过社会收益的高成本生产则有所减少。这些结果表明，由于破产导致的环境成本内部化不完整，是危险行业产业结构和安全投入的重要决定因素。（JEL G22, G33, L25, L71, Q35, Q52）

title: A Credible Approach for Measuring Inframarginal Participation in Energy Efficiency Programs
abstract: Economists have long argued that many recipients of energy-efficiency subsidies may be “non-additional,” getting paid to do what they would have done anyway. Demonstrating this empirically has been difficult, however, because of endogeneity concerns and other challenges. In this paper we use a regression discontinuity analysis to examine participation in a large-scale residential energy-efficiency program. Comparing behavior just on either side of several eligibility thresholds, we find that program participation increases with larger subsidy amounts, but that most households would have participated even with much lower subsidy amounts. We illustrate the welfare loss introduced by transfers to inframarginal participants and show how the optimal subsidy amount depends on the relative shares of marginal and inframarginal participants.
abstract_zh: 经济学家长期以来认为，许多能效补贴的领取者可能属于“非额外性”群体，即获得补贴去做他们本来就会做的事情。然而，由于内生性问题及其他挑战，以实证方式证明这一点一直十分困难。本文利用断点回归分析，考察一项大规模住宅能效项目中的参与情况。通过比较若干资格门槛两侧的行为，我们发现项目参与随补贴金额增加而上升，但大多数家庭即使在远低得多的补贴金额下也会参与。我们说明了向边际内参与者转移支付所带来的福利损失，并展示了最优补贴金额如何取决于边际参与者与边际内参与者的相对份额。

title: Assessing catch shares' effects: Evidence from federal United States and associated British Columbian fisheries
abstract: What are the effects of transitioning traditionally managed fisheries to incentive-based catch shares fisheries? In a study of all major United States federal catch share fisheries and associated shared stock fisheries in British Columbia, catch shares result in environmental improvements, economic improvements, and a mixture of changes in social performance, relative to the race for fish under traditional management. Environmentally, compliance with total allowable catch increases and discards decrease. Economically, vessel yields rise, total revenues grow, and long-term stock increases are encouraged. Socially, safety increases, some port areas modestly consolidate, needed processing capacity often reduces, and labor markets shift from part time jobs to full time jobs with similar total employment. Newer catch shares address many social concerns through careful design.
abstract_zh: 将传统管理的渔业转向以激励为基础的捕捞配额（catch share）渔业，会产生什么影响？在对美国所有主要联邦捕捞配额渔业以及不列颠哥伦比亚省相关共享资源渔业的研究中，与传统管理下的“抢鱼”竞争相比，捕捞配额带来了环境改善、经济改善，以及社会绩效的多种变化。在环境方面，对总允许捕捞量的遵守程度提高，丢弃量减少。在经济方面，船只产量提高，总收入增长，并促进了长期种群的增长。在社会方面，安全性提高，部分港口地区适度集中，所需的加工能力往往减少，劳动力市场从兼职工作转向全职工作，而总就业量基本保持不变。新的捕捞配额通过精心设计，解决了许多社会问题。

title: Prediction and verification of possible reef-fish spawning aggregation sites in Los Roques Archipelago National Park, Venezuela
Rhythms of gene expression in a fluctuating intertidal environment
Sharing the catch, conserving the fish
Costa Rica’s payment for environmental services program: Intention, implementation, and impact
abstract: We evaluated the intention, implementation, and impact of Costa Rica's program of payments for environmental services (PSA), which was established in the late 1990s. Payments are given to private landowners who own land in forest areas in recognition of the ecosystem services their land provides. To characterize the distribution of PSA in Costa Rica, we combined remote sensing with geographic information system databases and then used econometrics to explore the impacts of payments on deforestation. Payments were distributed broadly across ecological and socioeconomic gradients, but the 1997–2000 deforestation rate was not significantly lower in areas that received payments. Other successful Costa Rican conservation policies, including those prior to the PSA program, may explain the current reduction in deforestation rates. The PSA program is a major advance in the global institutionalization of ecosystem investments because few, if any, other countries have such a conservation history and because much can be learned from Costa Rica's experiences.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了哥斯达黎加环境服务付费计划（PSA）的意图、实施与影响，该计划设立于20世纪90年代末。付费发放给在森林地区拥有土地的私人土地所有者，以表彰其土地所提供的生态系统服务。为刻画哥斯达黎加PSA的分布情况，我们将遥感与地理信息系统数据库相结合，并运用计量经济学方法考察付费对森林砍伐的影响。付费在生态和社会经济梯度上分布较为广泛，但在获得付费的地区，1997–2000年的森林砍伐率并未显著更低。哥斯达黎加其他成功的保护政策（包括PSA计划实施之前的政策）可能解释了当前森林砍伐率的下降。PSA计划是全球生态系统投资制度化进程中的一大进步，因为很少（如果有的话）其他国家拥有如此悠久的保护历史，并且可以从哥斯达黎加的经验中学到很多东西。
